name: Rosewood Hong Kong
short_description: A stunning architectural icon on Victoria Harbour offering breathtaking views and legendary Rosewood hospitality.
description: Occupying a prime waterfront location in Tsim Sha Tsui, Rosewood Hong Kong redefines ultra-luxury hospitality with its dramatic vertical estate concept, exquisite interiors by Tony Chi, and sweeping views of Victoria Harbour. Featuring world-class dining, immersive wellness concepts at Asaya, and bespoke butler service, it is a masterpiece of modern luxury.
highlights: Victoria Harbour views, Asaya wellness sanctuary, Infinity pool overlooking the skyline, Holt's Cafe, DarkSide bar.
amenities: Outdoor infinity pool, Asaya wellness center, 24-hour butler service, state-of-the-art fitness center, chauffeur service, pet-friendly amenities.
dining_information: Holt's Cafe (British-Hong Kong tze char), The Butterfly Room, Legacy House (Cantonese), DarkSide (Cocktail bar).
spa_wellness: Asaya holistic wellness center offering integrative wellness therapies, fitness classes, and advanced skincare.
activities: Harbour cruises, bespoke art tours, wellness workshops, shopping excursions in Tsim Sha Tsui.
why_we_recommend: Unmatched harbour views, cutting-edge interior design, and legendary personalized service make it the pinnacle of modern luxury in Hong Kong.

name: Aman New York
short_description: An urban sanctuary of serenity and discretion designed by Renzo Piano in the heart of Manhattan.
description: Situated on West 57th Street, Aman New York brings the legendary peace and minimalist elegance of Aman to the vibrant energy of Manhattan. Housed within the historic Crown Building, it features expansive suites with private fireplaces, a three-story subterranean spa, and exclusive members' club spaces.
best_time_to_visit: September to November & April to June
highlights: Three-story subterranean spa, Japanese garden terrace, private fireplaces in suites, Arva Italian restaurant.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, 25,000 sq ft spa, Japanese garden terrace, cigar lounge, wine library, chauffeured house car.
dining_information: Arva (Italian fine dining), Nama (Japanese washoku), The Lounge & Bar.
spa_wellness: Comprehensive Aman Spa featuring indoor pool, treatment houses, hydrotherapy, and holistic wellness programs.
activities: Private Central Park tours, exclusive Broadway access, art gallery curation visits, fitness training.
why_we_recommend: It offers an unprecedented level of tranquility, privacy, and refined Asian hospitality right in the middle of Midtown Manhattan.

name: Cheval Blanc Paris
short_description: An exquisite art deco masterpiece by Peter Marino overlooking the River Seine in Paris.
description: Cheval Blanc Paris is a celebration of French art de vivre, combining historic architectural grandeur with contemporary chic. Located at Samaritaine, it offers breathtaking views of the Seine and iconic monuments, bespoke culinary experiences by Arnaud Donckele and Maxime Frédéric, and exclusive Dior Spa Cheval Blanc.
highlights: Direct Seine views, Dior Spa Cheval Blanc, Plénitude (3-Michelin-star dining), indoor swimming pool.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, Dior spa, valet parking, 24-hour butler service, private boat transfers.
dining_information: Plénitude (3 Michelin stars), Le Tout-Paris (contemporary brasserie), Langosteria (Italian seafood).
spa_wellness: Dior Spa Cheval Blanc featuring custom Dior treatments, vitality pools, and relaxation suites.
activities: Private Seine yacht cruises, private shopping at Samaritaine, art and museum tours.
why_we_recommend: Unrivaled views of Paris landmarks, exceptional gastronomic offerings, and the couture touch of Dior make it the ultimate Parisian retreat.

name: The Upper House
short_description: A tranquil minimalist sky palace perched above Pacific Place in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
description: Designed by visionary architect Andre Fu, The Upper House is an understated luxury hotel that feels like a chic private residence. Rooms feature natural wood, limestone bathrooms, and sweeping vistas of the harbor or verdant peaks, complemented by the vibrant Mediterranean restaurant Salisterra.
highlights: The Lawn outdoor terrace, iconic limestone freestanding bathtubs with views, Salisterra restaurant, minimalist design.
amenities: 24-hour fitness center, yoga studio, complimentary maxi bar, luxury house car transfers.
dining_information: Salisterra (Mediterranean dining by Ricardo Chaneton), The Continental.
spa_wellness: In-room wellness treatments, rooftop yoga classes, personalized wellness coaching.
activities: Private hiking tours of Dragon's Back, bespoke city art tours, wellness sessions.
why_we_recommend: Its serene residential aesthetic, exceptional personalized service, and stunning skyline views offer a peaceful escape in the heart of the city.

name: Raffles Singapore
short_description: The legendary grande dame of Singapore, birthplace of the Singapore Sling and timeless colonial luxury.
description: Established in 1887, Raffles Singapore is an oasis of colonial architecture, lush tropical gardens, and legendary hospitality. Following a meticulous restoration, it continues to welcome global travelers with its iconic white facade, graceful suites, and world-class culinary partnerships.
highlights: Long Bar (birthplace of Singapore Sling), 24-hour Raffles butler service, historic colonial architecture, Tiffin Room.
amenities: Outdoor swimming pool, Raffles Spa, boutique arcade, 24-hour butler service, fitness studio.
dining_information: Long Bar, Tiffin Room (North Indian), La Dame de Pic (Anne-Sophie Pic), BBR by Alain Ducasse.
spa_wellness: Raffles Spa offering holistic Asian-inspired treatments and hydrothermal facilities.
activities: Historical heritage tours with resident historian, cocktail masterclasses, orchid garden tours.
why_we_recommend: A living legend of hospitality that seamlessly blends 19th-century colonial romance with ultra-modern luxury and butler service.

name: Bulgari Tokyo
short_description: A sophisticated urban sanctuary blending Italian flair with Japanese minimalism in Tokyo's Ginza.
description: Bulgari Hotel Tokyo occupies the top floors of a sleek skyscraper in Yaesu, offering panoramic views of Mount Fuji and the Tokyo skyline. Featuring Italian design elements by Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel alongside exquisite Japanese craftsmanship, it is a statement of refined elegance.
best_time_to_visit: March to May (Cherry blossom season) & October to November
highlights: Bulgari Bar with rooftop terrace, Il Ristorante - Niko Romito, Bulgari Spa with indoor pool, Mount Fuji views.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, Bulgari Spa, state-of-the-art gym, private cinema, chauffeur service.
dining_information: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito (3 Michelin star chef concept), Bulgari Dolci, Sushi Hōseki.
spa_wellness: Bulgari Spa featuring bespoke L.RAPHAEL treatments, thermal bath, and relaxation lounge.
activities: Exclusive Ginza shopping tours, private tea ceremonies, architectural walks.
why_we_recommend: The ultimate fusion of Italian high jewellery glamour and Japanese precision craftsmanship high above Tokyo.

name: Burj Al Arab Jumeirah
short_description: The world's most luxurious sail-shaped architectural marvel rising from its own artificial island in Dubai.
description: Burj Al Arab Jumeirah is a global symbol of Arabian luxury, offering ultra-spacious duplex suites, a private beach, iconic terrace with infinity pools, and legendary chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royce transfers. Known for its gold-infused interiors and peerless VIP service.
highlights: Iconic sail architecture, private beach and deck with infinity pools, Rolls-Royce fleet, 24-karat gold interiors.
amenities: Private beach, Sal Beach Club, Talise Spa, Rolls-Royce airport transfers, helipad, butler service in every suite.
dining_information: Al Muntaha (French/Italian fine dining), L'Olivo at Al Mahara (underwater aquarium dining), Sahn Eddar.
spa_wellness: Talise Spa offering panoramic sea views, plunge pools, steam rooms, and luxury facial treatments.
activities: Yacht charters, desert safaris, skydiving experiences, helicopter tours from the hotel helipad.
why_we_recommend: An undisputed icon of opulent architectural design and over-the-top VIP pampering.

name: Hôtel Plaza Athénée
short_description: A legendary Parisian palace hotel on Avenue Montaigne famed for its red geraniums and haute couture legacy.
description: Hôtel Plaza Athénée has been synonymous with Parisian elegance since 1913. Located on the haute couture avenue of Montaigne, it features classic Louis XVI and Art Deco decor, Dior Institute spa, and exceptional gastronomy curated by Jean Imbert.
highlights: Courtyard covered in red geraniums, Dior Spa Plaza Athénée, Jean Imbert restaurant, Eiffel Tower views from suites.
amenities: Dior spa, fitness center, valet parking, chauffeur-driven luxury cars, pet-friendly services.
dining_information: Jean Imbert au Plaza Athénée, Le Relais Plaza (classic brasserie), La Cour Jardin, Le Bar.
spa_wellness: Dior Institute offering bespoke anti-aging treatments, hammam, sauna, and relaxation rooms.
activities: Private fashion house visits, haute couture fittings, Seine boat tours, pastry masterclasses.
why_we_recommend: The quintessential embodiment of Parisian chic, haute couture heritage, and unmatched luxury living on Avenue Montaigne.

name: Claridge’s
short_description: Mayfair's historic art deco crown jewel, celebrated for timeless British tradition and bespoke glamour.
description: Claridge’s has enchanted guests with its art deco grandeur and impeccable English style for over a century. Located in the heart of Mayfair, it is renowned for its legendary afternoon tea, Fera culinary excellence, and exceptional personalized butler service.
highlights: Legendary Afternoon Tea in the Foyer, Claridge's Bar, art deco design by Guy Oliver, L'Abreuvoir spa.
amenities: Claridge's Spa, 24-hour butler service, health club, chauffeured Rolls-Royce, private event spaces.
dining_information: Claridge's Restaurant, The Foyer & Reading Room, The Fumoir, Claridge's Bar.
spa_wellness: Claridge's Spa featuring restorative wellness treatments, swimming pool, and sauna facilities.
activities: Private Mayfair art gallery tours, bespoke shopping with royal warrant holders, historical hotel tours.
why_we_recommend: The absolute pinnacle of traditional British elegance, art deco heritage, and Mayfair sophistication.

name: The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto
short_description: A tranquil traditional Japanese ryokan-style luxury resort nestled in the historic hills of Arashiyama, Kyoto.
description: Overlooking the Oi River, The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto combines modern five-star luxury with authentic Kyoto tradition. Featuring serene tatami-style rooms, exquisite kaiseki dining, and peaceful garden courtyards, it offers a deeply restorative retreat into Japanese culture.
best_time_to_visit: March to May (Cherry blossom) & October to November (Autumn foliage)
highlights: River views of Arashiyama, Mizuki Japanese restaurant, traditional tea ceremonies, spa with indoor pool.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, luxury spa, fitness center, bicycle rentals, traditional tea house.
dining_information: Mizuki (Kaiseki, Sushi, Teppanyaki), La Baie (French fine dining), The Lobby Lounge.
spa_wellness: The Ritz-Carlton Spa offering ESPA treatments, hydrotherapy pools, and Japanese ritual baths.
activities: Private temple tours, Zen meditation sessions with monks, cycling along the Katsura River, kimono experiences.
why_we_recommend: Seamlessly integrates luxury hospitality with authentic Kyoto heritage along a serene river landscape.

name: Soneva Jani
short_description: An iconic overwater eco-luxury resort in the Maldives featuring waterslides and a retractable roof observatory.
description: Located in the untouched Noonu Atoll, Soneva Jani is a barefoot luxury paradise offering colossal overwater villas with private slides plunging into crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. Highlights include the overwater open-air cinema, stargazing observatory, and sustainable luxury philosophy.
highlights: Overwater villas with waterslides, retractable master bedroom roof for stargazing, Over-the-Stars Cinema, Eco-Centro.
amenities: Overwater observatory, open-air cinema, wine cellar, chocolate and ice cream parlors, private butler (Mr./Ms. Friday).
dining_information: The Gathering, Overseas by Mathias Dahlgren, So Wild by Diana Von Cranach, Down to Earth.
spa_wellness: Soneva Soul overwater wellness spa offering holistic treatments, Ayurveda, and yoga pavilions.
activities: Dolphin cruises, scuba diving with marine biologists, coral reef planting, stargazing astronomy dinners.
why_we_recommend: The ultimate barefoot luxury castaway fantasy with world-class eco-conscious design and private slides.

name: Soneva Fushi
short_description: The pioneering luxury barefoot hideaway in the Baa Atoll offering jungle villas and outdoor cinema.
description: Soneva Fushi is the original barefoot luxury resort in the Maldives, set on a lush private island in the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Featuring massive rustic-luxe villas hidden among jungle foliage, an open-air cinema, observatory, and an unwavering commitment to sustainability.
highlights: Private beach villas, Cinema Paradiso, Glass Studio, Junior Master Chef classes, Robinson Crusoe style.
amenities: Open-air cinema, observatory, organic gardens, 24/7 butler service, SCUBA diving center.
dining_information: Mihiree Mithaa, Out of the Blue, Fresh in the Garden, Down to Earth.
spa_wellness: Soneva Soul spa offering wellness therapies, yoga classes, and meditation in nature.
activities: Manta ray snorkeling excursions, turtle safaris, glassblowing workshops, private sandbank dining.
why_we_recommend: The pioneer of sustainable luxury where 'no news, no shoes' meets absolute five-star indulgence.

name: One&Only Reethi Rah
short_description: An ultra-exclusive private island sanctuary in the Maldives surrounded by pristine lagoons and coral reefs.
description: Spread across a sprawling private island in North Malé Atoll, One&Only Reethi Rah is the epitome of glamorous tropical seclusion. Boasting 12 pristine beaches, spectacular overwater and beachfront villas, and world-class culinary venues, it is a favorite for discerning travelers.
highlights: 12 pristine private beaches, ESPA spa courtyard, overwater villas with private pools, celebrity chef dining.
amenities: Multiple swimming pools, tennis courts, climbing wall, KidsOnly club, private yacht transfers.
dining_information: Reethi Restaurant, Tapasake (Japanese overwater), Fanditha (Middle Eastern beach lounge), Botanica.
spa_wellness: One&Only Spa by ESPA offering vitality pools, tranquil gardens, and bespoke wellness treatments.
activities: Private yacht charters, deep-sea fishing, wreck diving, tennis coaching, water sports.
why_we_recommend: Unmatched island spaciousness, pristine beaches, and world-class recreational facilities in the Maldives.

name: Cheval Blanc Randheli
short_description: An aquatic wonderland of water villas and bespoke luxury designed by Jean-Michel Gathy in Noonu Atoll.
description: Cheval Blanc Randheli is an ultra-exclusive Maison in the Maldives' Noonu Atoll. Featuring cathedral-ceiling villas with 12.5-meter private pools, dedicated Bamford spa treatments, and culinary mastery overseen by Michelin-starred chefs.
highlights: 12.5m private pools in every villa, dedicated Majordome service, Guerlain spa island, custom seaplane.
amenities: Private seaplane lounge, Guerlain spa, state-of-the-art diving center, tennis courts, kids' club.
dining_information: Le 1947 (Fine dining), The White, The Diptyque, Deelani (Mediterranean grill).
spa_wellness: Dedicated Guerlain spa island offering exclusive customized treatments and relaxation pavilions.
activities: Seaplane safari, sunset dolphin cruises, night snorkeling, private island castaway picnics.
why_we_recommend: The pinnacle of French chic and sophisticated island architecture in the Indian Ocean.

name: Amanpuri
short_description: The legendary hillside tropical sanctuary overlooking the Andaman Sea in Phuket, Thailand.
description: Nestled into a lush coconut grove cascading down a hillside to Pansea Beach, Amanpuri is the original crown jewel of the Aman resort empire. Known for its iconic Thai pavilions, turquoise swimming pools, holistic wellness center, and peerless serenity.
highlights: Private access to Pansea Beach, traditional Thai pavilion design, holistic wellness immersions, 27m main pool.
amenities: Holistic wellness center, Pilates studio, tennis courts, marine sports center, library, boutique.
dining_information: The Restaurant (Thai and Western), Arva (Italian), Nama (Japanese), The Beach Club.
spa_wellness: Amanpuri Wellness Centre featuring resident practitioners, hydrotherapy rooms, and yoga pavilion.
activities: Private yacht charters to Phang Nga Bay, Muay Thai training, scuba diving, pottery classes.
why_we_recommend: The timeless icon of Asian luxury resort design, offering absolute peace and legendary Aman hospitality.

name: Capella Ubud
short_description: A tranquil cliffside sanctuary suspended above the Ayung River valley in Ubud, Bali.
description: Capella Ubud is a tented camp luxury retreat designed by Bill Bensley, nestled deep within the rainforest of Keliki valley. Inspired by early 19th-century European explorers, it combines canvas luxury tents with saltwater pools and authentic Balinese healing traditions.
best_time_to_visit: April to October (Dry season in Bali)
highlights: Luxurious tented camps with private saltwater pools, Auriga Wellness spa, campfire storytelling sessions, jungle views.
amenities: Saltwater lap pools, Auriga Wellness tented spa, gymnasium, 24-hour Capella Culturist service.
dining_information: Mads Lange (camp dining), Api Jiwa (Asian omakase grill), The Mortar and Pestle bar.
spa_wellness: Auriga Wellness inspired by lunar cycles, offering organic Balinese treatments and rainforest yoga.
activities: Guided rice paddy treks, organic farming workshops, traditional Balinese blessing ceremonies, e-bike tours.
why_we_recommend: An extraordinarily imaginative jungle camp design that merges adventure with ultra-luxury comfort.

name: Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
short_description: An intimate sanctuary of riverside pool villas nestled between sacred temples and emerald rice paddies in Bali.
description: Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve offers an ultra-personalized retreat along the Ayung River in Ubud. Featuring traditional yet contemporary Javanese architecture, bespoke butler service (Patih), organic farm, and deeply spiritual wellness programs.
highlights: Ayung River valley setting, private butler (Patih) service, Mandapa Spa & Wellness, organic farm and paddy.
amenities: Outdoor swimming pool, wellness center, fitness studio, kids' club (The Mandapa Camp), library.
dining_information: Sawah Terrace (Indonesian cuisine), Kubu (Mediterranean dining in bamboo pods), The Library.
spa_wellness: Mandapa Spa offering holistic spa treatments, wellness consultations, river-facing yoga studio.
activities: Rice planting experiences, river rafting, cycling through Balinese villages, wellness cooking classes.
why_we_recommend: An immersive spiritual and natural retreat offering exquisite privacy and Ritz-Carlton Reserve's peerless care.

name: Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora
short_description: The quintessential South Pacific paradise offering thatched overwater bungalows with views of Mount Otemanu.
description: Perched over the turquoise lagoon of Bora Bora against the dramatic backdrop of Mount Otemanu, Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora offers luxurious overwater bungalows, beachfront villas, a unique lagoon sanctuary, and peerless Polynesian romance.
best_time_to_visit: May to October (Driest and coolest months)
highlights: Overwater bungalows with glass viewing panels, private lagoon sanctuary with rays, Mount Otemanu views, Fare Hoa Beach Bar.
amenities: Infinity pool, tennis courts, spa sanctuary, wedding chapel, children's program, catamaran.
dining_information: Arii Moana (Polynesian/French), Tere Nui, Vaimiti (overwater sushi), Fare Hoa Beach Bar.
spa_wellness: Tata'u Spa offering traditional Polynesian massage therapies and open-air treatment rooms.
activities: Shark and ray snorkeling safaris, deep-sea fishing, paddleboarding, sunset catamaran cruises.
why_we_recommend: The ultimate South Pacific dream escape featuring iconic overwater bungalows and legendary Four Seasons service.

name: One&Only Palmilla
short_description: A cliffside desert-meets-ocean luxury oasis in Los Cabos, Mexico, offering whale watching and authentic Mexican charm.
description: Perched where the desert meets the crashing waves of the Sea of Cortez, One&Only Palmilla is a legendary Baja resort. Featuring whitewashed hacienda-style rooms, swimmable beach coves, world-class golf, and culinary offerings by Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
best_time_to_visit: November to May (Pleasantly warm and dry)
highlights: Swimmable beach coves, One&Only Spa, Jack Nicklaus golf course, whale watching from private terraces.
amenities: Multiple pools, ESPA spa, tennis courts, boutique, private yacht charters, 24-hour butler service.
dining_information: Seared (steakhouse by Jean-Georges), Agua (Mexican fine dining), Suviche, The Pelican.
spa_wellness: Garden spa oasis offering holistic treatments, yoga pavilion, and plunge pools.
activities: Deep-sea fishing, seasonal whale watching tours, tequila tastings, surfing excursions.
why_we_recommend: The premier luxury retreat in Los Cabos combining dramatic cliffside ocean views with swimmable beaches.

name: Rosewood Mayakoba
short_description: An eco-luxury mangrove resort in the Riviera Maya, Mexico, blending Mayan heritage with modern elegance.
description: Immersed in lush emerald mangroves and lagoons along the Caribbean coast, Rosewood Mayakoba is a tranquil paradise. Reached via private electric boats, villas feature rooftop sundecks, plunge pools, and private docks, complemented by Sense Spa on its own private island.
highlights: Overwater lagoon suites with plunge pools, Sense Spa on private island, El Camaleón PGA golf course, boat transfers.
amenities: Multiple swimming pools, championship golf course, tennis courts, fitness center, kids' club.
dining_information: Casa Del Lago (Italian/Mexican), Zapote Bar, Punta Bonita (beachfront grill), Agave Study.
spa_wellness: Sense, A Rosewood Spa offering traditional Mayan healing rituals, hydrotherapy, and yoga.
activities: Eco-boat tours through mangroves, cenote diving, snorkeling on the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef, tequila masterclasses.
why_we_recommend: An exquisite eco-luxury resort offering serene mangrove canals, private plunge pools, and pristine white-sand beaches.

name: Royal Mansour
short_description: An opulent palace retreat inside Marrakech's historic medina featuring private riads and stunning gardens.
description: Royal Mansour Marrakech is an architectural masterpiece commissioned by King Mohammed VI. Instead of traditional hotel rooms, guests stay in luxurious private three-story riads surrounded by fragrant orange orchards, tranquil fountains, and subterranean service tunnels.
best_time_to_visit: March to May & September to November
highlights: Private multi-story riads with rooftop plunge pools, world-class spa with wrought-iron atrium, restaurants by Yannick Alléno.
amenities: Subterranean butler tunnels, outdoor grand pool, luxury spa, lush gardens, private chauffeurs.
dining_information: La Grande Table Marocaine, Le Jardin, Sesamo (Italian by Yannick Alléno), The Bar.
spa_wellness: Iconic Royal Mansour Spa featuring signature hammams, hydrotherapy pools, and holistic wellness suites.
activities: Medina private heritage tours, hot air balloon flights over Atlas Mountains, cooking classes.
why_we_recommend: Unrivaled Moorish craftsmanship and absolute privacy with individual multi-story riads in the heart of Marrakech.

name: Hotel Sacher Vienna
short_description: Vienna's legendary luxury hotel on the Ringstrasse, famed for creating the original Sachertorte.
description: Hotel Sacher Vienna stands proudly opposite the Vienna State Opera, embodying 19th-century imperial grandeur. Home of the world-famous Original Sacher-Torte, it combines historic Austrian tradition with exquisite contemporary comfort and Sacher Spa wellness.
best_time_to_visit: April to June & September to December (Christmas markets)
highlights: Original Sacher-Torte, location opposite Vienna State Opera, historic art collection, Sacher Spa.
amenities: Sacher Spa, fitness center, valet parking, private chauffeur, pet-friendly concierge.
dining_information: Café Sacher Wien, Rote Bar (traditional Viennese fine dining), Grüne Bar, Sacher Bar.
spa_wellness: Sacher Spa offering chocolate-infused body treatments, saunas, and relaxation lounges.
activities: Private opera tours, classical music concerts, historic city walking tours, Viennese waltz lessons.
why_we_recommend: The timeless epicenter of Viennese cultural heritage, imperial luxury, and culinary confectionary history.

name: The Savoy
short_description: London's legendary luxury hotel on the Strand, steeped in theatrical history and British elegance.
description: Overlooking the River Thames since 1889, The Savoy is an icon of British hospitality. Famed for its American Bar, Savoy Grill by Gordon Ramsay, and art deco and Edwardian design, it has hosted royalty, artists, and global leaders for over a century.
highlights: Thames River views, The American Bar (world's best cocktail bar), Savoy Grill by Gordon Ramsay, Beaufort Bar.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, fitness center, beauty salon, chauffeur service, 24-hour butler service in suites.
dining_information: Savoy Grill, 1890 by Gordon Ramsay, The River Restaurant, The American Bar, Beaufort Bar.
spa_wellness: Savoy Spa offering restorative treatments, indoor pool, sauna, and steam facilities.
activities: Private West End theatre tours, Thames private yacht cruises, historical hotel tours with archivist.
why_we_recommend: A legendary London landmark combining theatrical heritage, world-class dining, and exceptional butler service.

name: Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo
short_description: A legendary Belle Époque palace hotel on Casino Square in the heart of Monaco.
description: Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo is an icon of Mediterranean glamour since 1864. Featuring opulent Belle Époque architecture, direct access to Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo, and legendary Michelin-starred dining including Louis XV by Alain Ducasse.
highlights: Casino Square location, Le Louis XV - Alain Ducasse (3 Michelin stars), underground wine cellars, Thermes Marins access.
amenities: Direct access to Thermes Marins wellness center, private beach club access, rooftop pool, valet parking.
dining_information: Le Louis XV - Alain Ducasse, Le Grill, Ômer, Bar American.
spa_wellness: Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo offering state-of-the-art hydrotherapy, fitness, and seawater wellness treatments.
activities: Yacht charters in Monaco harbor, supercar driving experiences, private casino gaming lessons.
why_we_recommend: The undisputed palace of Monegasque glamour, high-stakes romance, and world-class Riviera gastronomy.

name: Hotel Cipriani, A Belmond Hotel
short_description: Venice's legendary luxury hideaway on Giudecca Island with iconic pool and timeless Venetian romance.
description: Hotel Cipriani, A Belmond Hotel, sits on the tip of Giudecca Island, offering stunning panoramic views of St. Mark's Square. Famed for its legendary seawater swimming pool, lush gardens, exquisite Cip's Club dining, and private wooden motorboat transfers.
best_time_to_visit: April to June & September to October
highlights: Olympic-sized unfiltered seawater swimming pool, Casanova's former garden, private wooden boat transfers to St. Mark's, Oro restaurant.
amenities: Seawater pool, Casanova Wellness Center, tennis court, private marina, children's club.
dining_information: Oro (1 Michelin star), Cip's Club, Porticciolo Restaurant, Bar Gabbiano.
spa_wellness: Casanova Wellness Center offering relaxing massages, facials, and open-air treatment cabanas.
activities: Private lagoon boat tours, Venetian mask-making workshops, wine tastings in Veneto vineyards.
why_we_recommend: The ultimate Venetian dream escape offering legendary privacy, stunning lagoon views, and unmatched romance.

name: Aman Venice
short_description: An intimate 16th-century palazzo right on the Grand Canal in Venice, restored by Aman.
description: Aman Venice is an architectural masterpiece set in the majestic 16th-century Palazzo Papadopoli on the Grand Canal. Featuring rococo artworks, private walled gardens (a rarity in Venice), and sumptuous suites designed by Jean-Michel Gathy.
best_time_to_visit: April to June & September to October
highlights: Grand Canal private boat arrival, private walled gardens, Tiepolo ceiling frescoes, Arva restaurant.
amenities: Private gardens, Aman Spa treatment rooms, library salon, private water taxi service.
dining_information: Arva (Italian fine dining), The Palazzo Dining Room, Aman Bar.
spa_wellness: Aman Spa offering holistic treatments drawing on traditional botanical ingredients.
activities: Private after-hours tours of St. Mark's Basilica, gondola boat building visits, lagoon art tours.
why_we_recommend: Unsurpassed palace grandeur on the Grand Canal combined with Aman's signature serene exclusivity.

name: Belmond Hotel Monasterio
short_description: A former 16th-century monastery turned luxury sanctuary in the Andean highlands of Cusco, Peru.
description: Belmond Hotel Monasterio is a historic treasure located in the heart of Cusco. Built as a monastery in 1592, it features oxygen-enriched rooms to combat altitude sickness, stunning baroque courtyards, and a priceless collection of colonial art.
highlights: Oxygen-enriched rooms, 16th-century chapel, colonial courtyard with 300-year-old cedar tree, Illariy restaurant.
amenities: Oxygen-enriched suites, spa treatment rooms, courtyard lounge, art gallery, concierge desk.
dining_information: Illariy (Andean fusion fine dining), El Monasterio Restaurant, Lobby Bar.
spa_wellness: Spa treatment rooms offering relaxing massages and coca-leaf herbal therapies.
activities: Private Cusco walking tours, Pisco sour masterclasses, excursions to Machu Picchu via Hiram Bingham train.
why_we_recommend: An immersive historical and spiritual journey into Andean heritage with oxygen-enriched comfort in Cusco.

name: Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor
short_description: A historic French colonial landmark hotel adjacent to the legendary Angkor Wat temples in Cambodia.
description: Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor has welcomed travelers exploring the mystical temples of Angkor since 1932. Surrounded by lush French gardens, it features timeless colonial architecture, a magnificent cage elevator, and the legendary Elephant Bar.
highlights: Proximity to Angkor Wat temples, classic cage elevator, Elephant Bar, iconic 35m swimming pool.
amenities: Freestyle swimming pool, Raffles Spa, tennis courts, boutique, 24-hour butler service.
dining_information: Restaurant Le Grand (Royal Khmer cuisine), 1932, The Conservatory, Elephant Bar.
spa_wellness: Raffles Spa offering traditional Khmer herbal massages and aromatherapy treatments.
activities: Private guided temple tours of Angkor Wat at sunrise, helicopter flights over ruins, Apsara dance dinners.
why_we_recommend: The historic gateway to Angkor Wat offering classic colonial charm, gracious hospitality, and timeless elegance.

name: Amangalla
short_description: A tranquil colonial sanctuary of calm within the historic walled fortress city of Galle, Sri Lanka.
description: Amangalla is housed within the historic 17th-century ramparts of Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Combining Dutch colonial architecture with tranquil gardens, high-ceilinged suites, and traditional Ayurvedic wellness, it is a haven of serenity.
best_time_to_visit: December to April (South coast dry season)
highlights: Historic Galle Fort rampart views, 17th-century colonial architecture, traditional Ayurvedic spa (The Baths), swimming pool.
amenities: Large garden swimming pool, spa and Ayurveda center, library, resident historian tours.
dining_information: The Dining Room (Sri Lankan and Western), The Verandah, The Great Hall.
spa_wellness: The Baths offering authentic Ayurvedic treatments, hydrotherapy pools, and yoga sessions.
activities: Guided walking tours of Galle Fort, tea plantation excursions, whale watching in Mirissa, cycling tours.
why_we_recommend: An authentic step back in time within a UNESCO fortress, offering sublime colonial architecture and serenity.

name: Copacabana Palace
short_description: South America's most iconic beachfront grand hotel overlooking Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro.
description: Opened in 1923, Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel, is the ultimate symbol of Brazilian glamour. Located directly on Copacabana Beach, it features art deco styling, a legendary rooftop pool, piano bar, and Michelin-starred dining.
best_time_to_visit: December to March (Carnival & Summer) & May to August (Mild)
highlights: Copacabana Beach frontage, iconic semi-olympic swimming pool, Mee (Pan-Asian Michelin star), Pérgula restaurant.
amenities: Rooftop tennis court, luxury spa, fitness center, beach service, private event salons.
dining_information: Mee (1 Michelin star), Cipriani Restaurant, Pérgula, Copacabana Piano Bar.
spa_wellness: Copacabana Palace Spa offering relaxing botanical treatments, sauna, and wellness studios.
activities: Private helicopter tours over Christ the Redeemer, samba dance classes, Favela cultural tours, yacht trips.
why_we_recommend: The legendary palace of Copacabana Beach where timeless glamour meets vibrant Brazilian rhythm.

name: Four Seasons Bangkok at Chao Phraya River
short_description: A contemporary riverside urban resort designed by Jean-Michel Gathy along Bangkok's Chao Phraya River.
description: Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River is a masterclass in modern riverfront luxury. Featuring soaring glass facades, terraced courtyards, vibrant art collections, and exceptional culinary destinations including BKK Social Club.
highlights: Chao Phraya River waterfront, BKK Social Club (Asia's 50 Best Bars), outdoor infinity pools, Jean-Michel Gathy design.
amenities: Two infinity pools, spa and wellness center, 24-hour fitness center, art gallery, private boat pier.
dining_information: Yu Ting Yuan (Cantonese fine dining), Riva del Sole, Brasserie Palmer, BKK Social Club.
spa_wellness: Urban Spa offering holistic Thai massages, body scrubs, and wellness recovery therapies.
activities: Long-tail boat temple tours, Thai cooking classes, mixology masterclasses, gallery hopping in Charoenkrung.
why_we_recommend: A striking modern riverside masterpiece offering world-class dining, bars, and cutting-edge design.

name: Capella Bangkok
short_description: An ultra-chic riverside sanctuary offering serene river views and refined butler service in Bangkok.
description: Capella Bangkok brings refined residential luxury to the banks of the Chao Phraya River. Every room features unobstructed river views, complemented by Michelin-starred gastronomic experiences by Mauro Colagreco and the serene Auriga Wellness.
highlights: All-riverside rooms and villas, Côte by Mauro Colagreco (Michelin-starred), Capella Culturists, private riverside verandas.
amenities: Outdoor saltwater lap pool, Auriga Wellness center, fitness center, private boat transfers.
dining_information: Côte by Mauro Colagreco (Riviera-inspired), Phra Nakhon (Thai riverside dining), Stella bar.
spa_wellness: Auriga Wellness offering hydrotherapy facilities, organic treatments, and traditional Thai therapies.
activities: Private river cruises, heritage walks in Charoenkrung district, Thai flower garland weaving workshops.
why_we_recommend: Impeccable personal service via Capella Culturists and unmatched riverside tranquility.

name: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok
short_description: The iconic grande dame of Bangkok hospitality set in lush tropical gardens along the Chao Phraya River.
description: Since 1876, Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok has been a legendary riverside haven, hosting literary greats like Joseph Conrad and Somerset Maugham. Famed for its legendary service, teakwood architecture, and Bamboo Bar jazz lounge.
highlights: Chao Phraya River location, The Bamboo Bar, Le Normandie by Alain Roux (2 Michelin stars), legendary Butler service.
amenities: Two outdoor swimming pools, Oriental Spa across the river, tennis courts, fitness center, cooking school.
dining_information: Le Normandie, The Verandah, Lord Jim's, Sala Rim Naam, The Bamboo Bar.
spa_wellness: The Oriental Spa offering Thai herbal treatments and holistic wellness in a teakwood house.
activities: Thai cooking classes, Muay Thai boxing, river boat transfers, flower arranging workshops.
why_we_recommend: A legendary sanctuary of Thai hospitality and literary heritage along the majestic Chao Phraya River.

name: Four Seasons Firenze
short_description: A magnificent 15th-century Renaissance palace hotel overlooking Florence and the Duomo.
description: Four Seasons Hotel Firenze is an urban resort set within a historic palazzo and former convent, surrounded by a stunning 11-acre private Renaissance park (Giardino della Gherardesca). Featuring original frescoes, Michelin-starred dining, and sublime Florentine luxury.
best_time_to_visit: May to June & September to October
highlights: 11-acre private Renaissance garden park, original 15th-century frescoes, Il Palagio (1 Michelin star), outdoor pool.
amenities: Outdoor swimming pool, luxury spa, tennis court, fitness center, historic chapel.
dining_information: Il Palagio (1 Michelin star), Atrium Bar, Al Fresco (poolside trattoria).
spa_wellness: The Spa featuring products by Santa Maria Novella, relaxation rooms, sauna, and holistic treatments.
activities: Private art gallery tours of Uffizi, Chianti wine tasting excursions, Renaissance art history lectures.
why_we_recommend: An extraordinary combination of museum-quality Renaissance art, historic parklands, and Four Seasons luxury in Florence.

name: Bulgari Roma
short_description: A glamorous jewelry-inspired luxury hotel steps from the Spanish Steps in Rome.
description: Bulgari Hotel Roma celebrates Roman history and the brand's high jewelry heritage. Overcoming Piazza Augusto Imperatore, it features magnificent travertine architecture, suites styled with iconic Bulgari motifs, and dining curated by Niko Romito.
best_time_to_visit: April to June & September to November
highlights: Piazza Augusto Imperatore location, Bulgari rooftop bar, Il Ristorante Niko Romito, indoor pool with mosaic tiling.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, Bulgari Spa, fitness center, private library, chauffeur service.
dining_information: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito, Bulgari Dolci, Bulgari Bar and Rooftop terrace.
spa_wellness: Bulgari Spa inspired by ancient Roman baths featuring mosaic pools and bespoke wellness treatments.
activities: Private after-hours tours of the Vatican, VIP shopping on Via Condotti, historic architectural walks.
why_we_recommend: Unmatched Roman glamour marrying Italian haute horlogerie/jewellery heritage with five-star hospitality.

name: Le Bristol Paris
short_description: An iconic Parisian palace on Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré offering timeless French elegance and Gastronomy.
description: Le Bristol Paris has been a bastion of refined French art de vivre since 1925. Famed for its sun-filled interior courtyard garden, 3-Michelin-star Epicure restaurant, rooftop pool overlooking the Eiffel Tower, and resident cat Fa-Raon.
highlights: Epicure (3 Michelin stars), rooftop indoor pool with Eiffel Tower views, 1,200 sq m courtyard garden, resident cat.
amenities: Rooftop indoor pool, La Prairie spa, fitness center, courtyard garden, valet parking.
dining_information: Epicure (3 Michelin stars), 114 Faubourg (1 Michelin star), Café Bristol, Le Bar Bristol.
spa_wellness: Le Bristol by La Prairie spa featuring Russian banya, solarium, and bespoke anti-aging treatments.
activities: Private pâtisserie masterclasses with chef Maxime Frédéric, private museum tours, fashion boutique visits.
why_we_recommend: The pinnacle of authentic French palace luxury, renowned cuisine, and warm family-friendly hospitality.

name: Four Seasons Hotel George V
short_description: The legendary palace hotel near the Champs-Élysées known for its historic grandeur and gastronomic excellence.
description: Opened in 1928, Four Seasons Hotel George V is an art deco masterpiece just off the Golden Triangle of Paris. Famed for its breathtaking floral displays by Jeff Leatham, three Michelin-starred dining experiences, and palatial suites.
highlights: Jeff Leatham floral installations, Le Cinq (3 Michelin stars), indoor swimming pool, courtyard dining.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, luxury spa, 24-hour fitness center, courtyard garden, chauffeur service.
dining_information: Le Cinq (3 Michelin stars), Le George (1 Michelin star), L'Orangerie (1 Michelin star), Bar.Le George.
spa_wellness: The Spa at Four Seasons George V offering cutting-edge facials, hydrotherapy, and custom massages.
activities: Private wine cellar tastings with head sommelier, perfume creation masterclasses, private Louvre tours.
why_we_recommend: Unrivaled Michelin-starred dining under one roof and breathtaking floral artistry in the heart of Paris.

name: The Peninsula Hong Kong
short_description: Hong Kong's legendary 'Grande Dame of the Far East' offering timeless colonial luxury and Rolls-Royce fleet.
description: Operating since 1928, The Peninsula Hong Kong is an enduring symbol of colonial grandeur on the Kowloon waterfront. Famous for its classic afternoon tea in the lobby, green Rolls-Royce Phantom fleet, and rooftop helipad.
highlights: Victoria Harbour views, iconic Rolls-Royce Phantom fleet, rooftop helipad, classic Lobby Afternoon Tea, Felix restaurant.
amenities: Roman-style indoor swimming pool, Peninsula Spa, fitness center, shopping arcade, rooftop helipad.
dining_information: Gaddi's (French fine dining), Spring Moon (Cantonese), Felix, The Lobby.
spa_wellness: The Peninsula Spa offering Ayurvedic and European wellness therapies with harbour views.
activities: Helicopter city tours, Peninsula Academy craft workshops, heritage harbor cruises on historical ferries.
why_we_recommend: The legendary grande dame of Asian hospitality, offering unmatched heritage and Rolls-Royce transfers.

name: The St. Regis New York
short_description: A historic Fifth Avenue luxury landmark in New York City famed for its King Cole Bar and Old World elegance.
description: Opened by John Jacob Astor IV in 1904, The St. Regis New York is a Midtown Manhattan icon. Known for its bespoke butler service, elegant crystal chandeliers, the birthplace of the Bloody Mary at King Cole Bar, and timeless Fifth Avenue sophistication.
best_time_to_visit: September to November & April to June
highlights: King Cole Bar (birthplace of the Red Snapper/Bloody Mary), 24-hour St. Regis Butler service, Fifth Avenue location.
amenities: Iridium Spa, 24-hour fitness center, house car service, chauffeur-driven Bentley, private event salons.
dining_information: King Cole Bar, Astor Court.
spa_wellness: Iridium Spa offering custom facials, massage therapies, and steam rooms.
activities: Private Fifth Avenue shopping consultations, Central Park carriage tours, museum docent visits.
why_we_recommend: A historic Fifth Avenue masterpiece offering legendary butler service and classic New York aristocracy charm.

name: The Connaught
short_description: A legendary Mayfair luxury hotel celebrated for its discreet service and the iconic Coburg Bar.
description: Situated on Carlos Place in Mayfair, The Connaught has been a home away from home for royalty and connoisseurs since 1897. Featuring exquisite British-meets-French design, the Aman Spa at The Connaught, and culinary brilliance by Hélène Darroze.
highlights: Hélène Darroze at The Connaught (3 Michelin stars), The Coburg Bar, Aman Spa with indoor pool, Mayfair location.
amenities: Indoor swimming pool, Aman Spa, 24-hour butler service, fitness center, chauffeur service.
dining_information: Hélène Darroze at The Connaught (3 Michelin stars), The Connaught Grill, The Coburg Bar, The Red Room.
spa_wellness: Aman Spa at The Connaught offering signature Eastern wellness treatments, pool, and steam rooms.
activities: Private Mayfair art gallery tours, bespoke tailoring consultations on Savile Row, historic hotel tours.
why_we_recommend: Unsurpassed Mayfair discretion, world-class 3-Michelin-star dining, and legendary British charm.

name: Singita Sabi Sand
short_description: An exclusive luxury safari lodge perched along the Sand River in South Africa's legendary Sabi Sand Reserve.
description: Singita Bembeni / Sabi Sand is an ultra-exclusive wilderness lodge offering unrivaled leopard viewing and pristine wilderness immersion. Featuring stunning contemporary suites with private plunge pools, expert trackers, and world-class wine cellars.
best_time_to_visit: May to September (Dry winter months for game viewing)
highlights: Big Five game viewing, leopard sightings, private plunge pools, award-winning wine cellar, open safari vehicles.
amenities: Outdoor swimming pools, Singita spa, gym, boutique and gallery, airstrip access.
dining_information: Bespoke fine dining crafted by private chefs, traditional boma dinners under the stars, extensive wine cellar.
spa_wellness: Singita Wellness spa offering organic African therapies, massage, and yoga overlooking the bushveld.
activities: Twice-daily game drives, guided bush walks, stargazing safaris, community village visits.
why_we_recommend: The gold standard of African conservation safari luxury with peerless leopard sightings and exquisite lodge design.

name: Singita Kruger National Park
short_description: A pristine wilderness safari sanctuary in South Africa's Kruger National Park offering absolute seclusion.
description: Singita Lebombo Lodge is perched dramatically on a cliff edge overlooking the N’Wanetsi River in Kruger National Park. Featuring glass-walled suites suspended over the wilderness, contemporary architectural design, and world-class wildlife tracking.
best_time_to_visit: May to September (Dry winter game viewing)
highlights: Cliffside glass suites overlooking river, prolific Big Five wildlife, rooftop sleep-out experiences, wine studio.
amenities: Lap swimming pool, Singita Spa, fitness center, wine studio, airstrip, gallery.
dining_information: African-inspired gourmet dining, interactive open kitchen, wine pairings from private cellar.
spa_wellness: Singita Spa offering wellness treatments inspired by African botanicals and holistic healing.
activities: Game drives in open-land Rovers, bush walks, bird watching, astronomy stargazing.
why_we_recommend: Stunning modernist cliffside architecture combined with one of Africa's most pristine wildlife conservation areas.

name: Badrutt’s Palace
short_description: An iconic alpine palace hotel in St. Moritz offering legendary Swiss glamour and winter sports luxury.
description: Badrutt’s Palace Hotel has defined luxury hospitality in St. Moritz since 1896. Overlooking Lake St. Moritz and the Engadin Alps, it offers legendary winter skiing, a subterranean spa, legendary nightlife at King's Social Club, and peerless Swiss service.
best_time_to_visit: December to April (Ski season) & July to August (Alpine summer)
highlights: Engadin Alps and Lake St. Moritz views, Palace Spa with outdoor infinity pool, King's Social Club, Rolls-Royce transfers.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor pools, Palace Spa, tennis courts, private ski school, Rolls-Royce fleet.
dining_information: IGNIV by Andreas Caminada (2 Michelin stars), La Coupole-Matsuhisa, Chesa Veglia, Le Restaurant.
spa_wellness: Palace Spa offering holistic alpine treatments, Finnish saunas, hydrotherapy, and snow rooms.
activities: Skiing and snowboarding in St. Moritz, bobsleigh rides, alpine hiking, horse-drawn carriage rides around the lake.
why_we_recommend: The legendary alpine playground for global aristocracy, offering unmatched winter sports and palace luxury.

name: The Chedi Andermatt
short_description: A striking alpine architectural masterpiece in the heart of Andermatt, Switzerland, blending Asian minimalism with Swiss warmth.
description: The Chedi Andermatt is a stunning luxury hotel nestled in the Swiss Alps, designed by Jean-Michel Gathy. Combining traditional alpine chalet elements with Asian aesthetic principles, it features glass fireplaces, extensive wine libraries, and a 2,400-sq-m spa.
best_time_to_visit: December to April (Skiing) & July to September (Hiking)
highlights: 2,400 sq m Spa & Health Club with indoor/outdoor pools, Cheese Tower, ski butler service, Michelin-starred Japanese restaurant.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor pools, award-winning spa, ski butler service, cigar lounge, wine library.
dining_information: The Restaurant (Asian and Swiss dining), The Japanese Restaurant (1 Michelin star), The Wine and Cigar Library.
spa_wellness: The Chedi Spa featuring Tibetan relaxation lounge, hydrotherapy, saunas, and custom massages.
activities: Heliskiing, championship golf on Andermatt Swiss Alps Golf Course, alpine hiking, snowshoeing.
why_we_recommend: A breathtaking fusion of Asian zen and Swiss alpine grandeur with an exceptional spa and ski butler service.

name: Capella Sydney
short_description: A sleek luxury hotel overlooking Sydney Harbour and the iconic Opera House.
description: Capella Sydney occupies a magnificently restored historic Department of Lands building in the Sandstone Precinct. Featuring soaring interior atriums, contemporary art collections, and sophisticated rooms overlooking Sydney Harbour.
best_time_to_visit: September to November (Spring) & March to May (Autumn)
highlights: Restored heritage sandstone architecture, 20-meter indoor pool in vaulted atrium, Capella Culturists, proximity to Sydney Opera House.
amenities: Indoor heated swimming pool, Auriga spa, 24-hour fitness center, executive lounge.
dining_information: Brasserie 1930, Aperture lounge bar, The Living Room.
spa_wellness: Auriga Spa offering Australian botanical treatments, wellness therapy rooms, and steam rooms.
activities: Private Sydney Harbour yacht charters, behind-the-scenes Sydney Opera House tours, coastal bushwalks.
why_we_recommend: An architectural masterpiece in downtown Sydney offering bespoke cultural curation and sophisticated luxury.

name: Southern Ocean Lodge
short_description: An award-winning eco-luxury wilderness lodge perched on the rugged cliffs of Kangaroo Island, South Australia.
description: Southern Ocean Lodge offers breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the wild Southern Ocean from its cliffside vantage point on Kangaroo Island. Featuring minimalist pavilion suites, exceptional local South Australian gastronomy, and immersive wildlife encounters.
best_time_to_visit: December to February (Warm Australian summer) & September to November
highlights: Cliffside ocean views from all suites, Kangaroo Island wildlife safaris, Southern Spa, Kangaroo Island gastronomy.
amenities: Plunge pools in suites, Southern Spa, open bar lounge, guided expedition vehicles, airstrip transfers.
dining_information: The Great Room (seasonal South Australian cuisine and local wines), terrace bar.
spa_wellness: Southern Spa featuring signature Li'Tya treatments incorporating indigenous Australian healing plants.
activities: Guided coastal walks, sea lion colony visits, koala tracking excursions, Remarkable Rocks tours.
why_we_recommend: The ultimate Australian coastal wilderness retreat combining cutting-edge sustainable design with rugged nature.

name: Six Senses Douro Valley
short_description: A tranquil wine estate luxury retreat set among terraced vineyards in Portugal's UNESCO Douro Valley.
description: Six Senses Douro Valley is housed in a magnificently renovated 19th-century manor house overlooking the winding Douro River and terraced vineyards. Famed for its world-class Six Senses Spa, wine academy, and holistic wellness philosophy.
best_time_to_visit: May to October (Harvest and warm weather)
highlights: UNESCO Douro Valley vineyard views, world-class Six Senses Spa, Wine Library and Academy, outdoor infinity pool.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor pools, 2,200 sq m spa, organic garden, wine cellar, fitness center.
dining_information: Vale de Abraão Restaurant, The Dining Room, The Wine Library & Terrace.
spa_wellness: Six Senses Spa offering personalized wellness screenings, yoga, hydrotherapy, and regional grape-based treatments.
activities: Port wine blending workshops, river cruises on traditional rabelo boats, helicopter tours, vineyard hikes.
why_we_recommend: The premier wine wellness retreat in Europe combining Douro Valley heritage with Six Senses holistic care.

name: Four Seasons Resort Hualalai
short_description: A legendary oceanfront luxury resort along the sun-drenched Kohala Coast of Hawaii's Big Island.
description: Four Seasons Resort Hualalai captures the authentic spirit of Hawaii along a dramatic volcanic coastline. Featuring palm-fringed white-sand beaches, King's Pond (a 1.8-million-gallon aquarium pool with eagle rays), championship golf, and luxurious bungalow suites.
highlights: King's Pond snorkel aquarium with rays, Jack Nicklaus signature golf course, oceanfront pools, cultural center.
amenities: Multiple swimming pools, Hualalai Spa, tennis courts, fitness center, marine activity center.
dining_information: Ulu Ocean Grill + Sushi Lounge, Beach Tree (Italian beachfront), Hualalai Grille.
spa_wellness: Hualalai Spa offering open-air garden treatment hales, bamboo massages, and hydrotherapy.
activities: Snorkeling with marine biologists, helicopter volcano tours, whale watching excursions, outrigger canoeing.
why_we_recommend: The gold standard of Hawaiian resort luxury with unparalleled marine life encounters and authentic island culture.

name: Amanoi
short_description: An architectural cliffside sanctuary overlooking a crescent bay in Vietnam's Nông Trấn (Ninh Thuan) coastal national park.
description: Amanoi sits within the pristine wilderness of Nui Chua National Park, cascading down verdant hills to a private crescent-shaped beach on Vinh Hy Bay. Inspired by traditional Vietnamese architecture, pavilions feature private pools and serene lake views.
highlights: Cliffside infinity pool, private pristine white-sand beach, Aman Spa wellness villas overlooking lotus lake, Nui Chua National Park setting.
amenities: Cliffside pool, private beach club, tennis courts, water sports center, wellness villas.
dining_information: The Central Pavilion (Vietnamese and international cuisine), The Beach Club.
spa_wellness: Aman Spa featuring two hydrotherapy wellness villas, yoga pavilion, and traditional Vietnamese treatments.
activities: Guided hikes in Nui Chua National Park, snorkeling and scuba diving in Vinh Hy Bay, pottery village visits.
why_we_recommend: A breathtaking national park sanctuary offering pristine coastal waters and absolute peace in Vietnam.

name: The Datai Langkawi
short_description: An eco-luxury rainforest sanctuary nestled within a 10-million-year-old rainforest in Langkawi, Malaysia.
description: The Datai Langkawi is a legendary luxury eco-resort nestled deep inside an ancient rainforest and opening onto the pristine Datai Bay. Designed to blend seamlessly into nature, it offers elevated canopy villas, championship golf, and world-class nature walks.
highlights: 10-million-year-old rainforest setting, Datai Bay beach, The Spa featuring Malay ramuan treatments, resident naturalists.
amenities: Swimming pools, championship golf course (The Els Club), fitness center, nature center, tennis courts.
dining_information: The Gulai House (Malay cuisine in the rainforest), The Pavilion, The Dining Room, Beach Club.
spa_wellness: The Datai Spa offering traditional Malay healing treatments (ramuan) amidst the rainforest canopy.
activities: Guided rainforest walks with resident naturalists, hornbill spotting, sea kayaking, cooking classes.
why_we_recommend: An immersive luxury rainforest and beach sanctuary where wildlife and pristine nature take center stage.
